ISO 11930 : Preservative Efficacy Test of Cosmetics

ISO 11930 specifies a procedure to evaluate preservation efficacy and  microbiological risk assessment of cosmetic products. The objective of  ISO 11930 is to ensure overall antimicrobial protection of cosmetic products for end users.


ISO 11930 is applicable to water soluble/miscible cosmetic products.


ISO 11930 test method steps involved - 

Inoculation - ISO 11930 begins with inoculation of the cosmetic product sample with mandatory test microorganisms.  

Incubation - Inoculated samples are kept at room temperature in the incubator for a total time period of 28 days.

Serial dilution and plating -   Recovered  incubated samples  are subjected to serial dilution, followed by plating and incubation to enumerate viable test microbes. 

Observation : For each time point, microbial growth, and log reduction values are calculated, and compared to the minimum values for the evaluation criteria.
